capitalPath.zhCn: 加拿大教育与东京、纽约交易系统职业形成工程和行业资本
capitalPath.en: Canadian education and trading-systems work in Tokyo and New York built engineering and industry capital

capitalPath.zhCn: 进入 Blockchain.info、OKCoin 等加密企业并积累网络与资产
capitalPath.en: Entered crypto through Blockchain.info, OKCoin, and related ventures, building networks and assets

capitalPath.zhCn: 2017年联合创立 Binance；主要财富来自公司权益和相关代币经济敞口
capitalPath.en: Co-founded Binance in 2017; principal wealth comes from company interests and token-economy exposure

finding.zhCn: 控制性权益得到监管和公司材料支持，精确比例会随口径变化
finding.en: A controlling interest is supported by regulatory and company material; exact percentages vary by definition

finding.zhCn: 本人称持有 BNB，但个人与公司分配的完整边界未公开
finding.en: He has disclosed holding BNB, but the full personal-company allocation boundary is unpublished

finding.zhCn: 交易所托管客户资产不能计入个人财富
finding.en: Exchange-custodied customer assets cannot be counted as personal wealth

finding.zhCn: 公司历史、监管文件和司法记录确认
finding.en: Confirmed by company history, regulatory filings, and court records

finding.zhCn: 不符合公开结构；核心是 Binance 权益及加密资产敞口
finding.en: Inconsistent with the public structure; Binance interests and crypto exposure are central

finding.zhCn: 错误；其于2023年认罪协议后辞任 CEO
finding.en: Incorrect; he resigned as CEO following the 2023 plea agreement

claim.zhCn: 2026年本人称目前无意担任 CEO 或回到 Binance
claim.en: In 2026 he said he has no current plan to be CEO or return to Binance

finding.zhCn: 2026年6月 CoinDesk 采访中的本人陈述；他未排除将来返回，该说法也不能证明经济权益已出售
finding.en: His statement in a June 2026 CoinDesk interview; he left open a later return, and the statement does not prove the economic interest was sold

openQuestions.zhCn: 其对 Binance 各地区实体的当前经济权益和表决安排如何？
openQuestions.en: What are his current economic and voting interests across Binance entities?

openQuestions.zhCn: 个人 BNB、BTC及其他钱包在税务和托管层面的完整余额是多少？
openQuestions.en: What are the complete taxable and custodial balances of personal BNB, BTC, and other wallets?

summary.zhCn: 补入2026年6月 CoinDesk 采访：本人称目前无意担任 CEO 或回到 Binance，并口述向 Prison Professors 捐赠约200万美元。
summary.en: Added the June 2026 CoinDesk interview in which he said he has no current CEO plans and does not intend to return to Binance, plus his self-reported donation of about US$2 million to Prison Professors.
